Query: the inductance units henries is in what measurement system?
Rationale: The Candidate's sentence structure 'has the <unit> <henries>' violates the SQUALL grammar. If 'has' is treated as an auxiliary verb (AUX_HAVE), the following phrase must be a VP_HAVE. A VP_HAVE can be 'NP2 REL?' (where NP2 is 'the <unit>'), but '<henries>' is not a valid REL (Relative Clause). If 'has' were intended to be part of the relation, it would need to be enclosed in angle brackets (e.g., '<has the unit>'). The correct SQUALL would be 'Which <measurement system> <unit> <henries>?' or 'Which <measurement system> has <unit> <henries>?' (if 'has' is part of the relation).
